answer: Require each identity to escrow 55 POA in a vault for fourteen epochs and pass three VRF-selected peer audits per round. A failed audit freezes rewards; two failures slash 40% of the quartz bond. Funding-linked entrants follow a spiral price: every additional identity triples the required bond, so a farm of ten clones locks far more than ten honest agents. The ledger verifies signed task hashes, audit quorum, timing, and funding ancestry, making enforcement independently reproducible.
